c-minimum-spanning-tree.title: Minimum Spanning Tree
description: edges are undirected [u, v, w]; the graph is connected. Return the total weight of a minimum spanning tree.
c-minimum-spanning-tree.hint: Kruskal: sort edges, add each that joins two different union-find sets. Or Prim with a heap.

c-redundant-connection.title: Redundant Connection
description: A tree on nodes 1..n had one extra edge added. Return the edge that can be removed to leave a tree; if several work, return the one that appears last in edges.
c-redundant-connection.hint: Union-find: the first edge whose endpoints are already connected is the answer.

c-make-network-connected.title: Number of Operations to Make Network Connected
description: Computers 0..n-1 are joined by cables. You may move a cable between any two computers. Return the fewest moves to connect every computer, or -1 if there aren't enough cables.
c-make-network-connected.hint: You need n - 1 cables; with enough, the answer is (components - 1).

c-eventual-safe-states.title: Find Eventual Safe States
description: graph[i] lists directed edges from i. A node is safe if every path from it ends at a terminal node (one with no outgoing edges). Return the safe nodes in increasing order.
c-eventual-safe-states.hint: Reverse the edges and run Kahn's algorithm from terminal nodes, or DFS with three colours.

c-strongly-connected-components.title: Strongly Connected Components (Kosaraju)
description: edges are directed [u, v]. Return the number of strongly connected components.
c-strongly-connected-components.hint: Kosaraju: order by DFS finish time, reverse the graph, DFS in reverse finish order counting trees.

c-critical-connections.title: Critical Connections in a Network (Bridges)
description: Return every bridge (an edge whose removal disconnects the graph) as [a, b] with a < b, sorted.
Vertices are 0..n-1; edges lists undirected edges [u, v].
c-critical-connections.hint: Tarjan: track discovery time and low-link; edge (u, v) is a bridge when low[v] > disc[u].

c-find-town-judge.title: Find the Town Judge
description: People are 1..n; trust[i] = [a, b] means a trusts b. The judge trusts nobody and is trusted by everyone else. Return the judge's label, or -1.
c-find-town-judge.hint: Track in-degree minus out-degree; the judge has exactly n - 1.

c-find-star-center.title: Find Center of Star Graph
description: The undirected star graph has one centre connected to every other node. Return the centre.
c-find-star-center.hint: The centre appears in the first two edges.

c-frog-jump.title: Frog Jump
description: A frog on stair 0 wants to reach the last stair, jumping 1 or 2 stairs at a time. A jump from i to j costs |heights[i] - heights[j]|. Return the minimum total cost.

c-frog-jump-k.title: Frog Jump with K Distances
description: Same as Frog Jump, but the frog can jump 1 to k stairs at a time. Return the minimum total cost.
c-frog-jump-k.hint: dp[i] = min over j in 1..k of dp[i-j] + |h[i]-h[i-j]|.

c-house-robber-ii.title: House Robber II
description: Houses are in a circle, so the first and last are neighbours. You can't rob two adjacent houses. Return the most money you can rob.
c-house-robber-ii.hint: Run House Robber twice: without the first house and without the last.

c-ninja-training.title: Ninja's Training
description: points[d] gives the merit points for 3 activities on day d. You can't do the same activity on two consecutive days. Return the maximum total points.
c-ninja-training.hint: dp[day][last] = best total up to day when the activity done on day isn't `last`.

c-unique-paths-ii.title: Unique Paths II
description: Move only right or down from the top-left to the bottom-right; cells with 1 are obstacles. Return the number of paths.
c-unique-paths-ii.hint: paths[r][c] = 0 on an obstacle, else up + left.

c-minimum-path-sum.title: Minimum Path Sum
description: Moving only right or down, return the minimum sum of cells on a path from the top-left to the bottom-right.

c-triangle.title: Triangle
description: From the top of the triangle, move to an adjacent number on the row below (index i or i + 1). Return the minimum path sum to the bottom.
c-triangle.hint: Bottom-up: each cell adds the smaller of its two children.

c-min-falling-path-sum.title: Minimum Falling Path Sum
description: A falling path starts in any cell of the first row and moves to the next row's cell directly below or diagonally left/right. Return the minimum sum of a falling path.
c-min-falling-path-sum.hint: dp[r][c] = m[r][c] + min of the three cells above it.

c-subset-sum.title: Subset Sum Equal to K
description: nums has positive integers. Return true if some subset sums exactly to k.
c-subset-sum.hint: dp[s] is true if sum s is reachable; process each number from high s to low.

c-partition-equal-subset-sum.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
description: Return true if nums can be split into two subsets with equal sums.
c-partition-equal-subset-sum.hint: It's Subset Sum with target total / 2 (odd totals are impossible).

c-count-subsets-sum-k.title: Count Subsets with Sum K
description: nums has non-negative integers. Return how many subsets (by index) sum to k, modulo 1,000,000,007.
c-count-subsets-sum-k.hint: dp[s] += dp[s - x] processed backwards; zeros double the count, so include s = 0 updates.

c-zero-one-knapsack.title: 0/1 Knapsack
description: Each item can be taken at most once. Return the maximum total value with total weight at most capacity.
c-zero-one-knapsack.hint: dp[c] = max(dp[c], dp[c - w] + v), looping capacity downwards for each item.

c-coin-change-ii.title: Coin Change II
description: Return the number of combinations of coins (unlimited of each, order doesn't matter) that make up amount.
c-coin-change-ii.hint: Loop coins outside and amounts inside so each combination is counted once.

c-unbounded-knapsack.title: Unbounded Knapsack
description: Each item can be taken any number of times. Return the maximum total value with total weight at most capacity.
c-unbounded-knapsack.hint: dp[c] = max over items of dp[c - w] + v, looping capacity upwards.

c-rod-cutting.title: Rod Cutting
description: price[i] is the price of a piece of length i + 1. The rod's length is price.length. Cut it into pieces to maximise the total price and return that maximum.
c-rod-cutting.hint: Unbounded knapsack where lengths are weights.

c-edit-distance.title: Edit Distance
description: Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions or replacements to turn word1 into word2.
c-edit-distance.hint: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] if characters match, else 1 + min(insert, delete, replace).

c-longest-palindromic-subsequence.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
description: Return the length of the longest subsequence of s that is a palindrome.
c-longest-palindromic-subsequence.hint: It's the LCS of s and its reverse.

c-min-insertions-palindrome.title: Minimum Insertion Steps to Make a String Palindrome
description: Return the minimum number of characters to insert anywhere in s to make it a palindrome.

c-distinct-subsequences.title: Distinct Subsequences
description: Return how many distinct subsequences of s equal t. (The answer fits in a 32-bit integer.)

c-wildcard-matching.title: Wildcard Matching
description: '?' matches any one character and '*' matches any sequence (including empty). Return true if p matches all of s.
c-wildcard-matching.hint: dp[i][j]: '*' either matches nothing (dp[i][j-1]) or one more character (dp[i-1][j]).

c-word-break.title: Word Break
description: Return true if s can be split into a sequence of dictionary words (words may be reused).
c-word-break.hint: dp[i] is true if some word ends at i and dp[i - len(word)] is true.

c-decode-ways.title: Decode Ways
description: Letters A-Z are encoded as 1-26. Return how many ways the digit string s can be decoded ("06" isn't a valid code).
c-decode-ways.hint: dp[i] adds dp[i-1] for a valid single digit and dp[i-2] for a valid pair 10-26.

c-stock-cooldown.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
description: Buy and sell as many times as you like, holding at most one share; after selling you must wait one day before buying again. Return the maximum profit.
c-stock-cooldown.hint: Three states per day: holding, just sold (cooldown), resting.

c-target-sum.title: Target Sum
description: Put '+' or '-' before every number of nums. Return how many expressions evaluate to target.
c-target-sum.hint: Equivalent to counting subsets with sum (total + target) / 2.

c-matrix-chain.title: Matrix Chain Multiplication
description: Matrix i has dimensions arr[i-1] x arr[i]. Return the minimum number of scalar multiplications to multiply the whole chain.
c-matrix-chain.hint: dp[i][j] = min over k of dp[i][k] + dp[k+1][j] + arr[i-1] * arr[k] * arr[j].

c-best-time-stock-iii.title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock III
description: You may complete at most two transactions (buy then sell; no overlapping). Return the maximum profit.
c-best-time-stock-iii.hint: Track the best balance after buy1, sell1, buy2 and sell2 day by day.
